rationale: This is the final wave, so we are deploying all three remaining drones to maximize life-saving intelligence across unscanned high-occupancy zones and unresolved collapse sites. D1 and D2 will sweep densely populated, unscanned blocks at Rincon Annex, PG&E, and 50 Fremont Center, while resolving high-occupancy discrepancies along Market and Pine Streets. D3 will verify reports of trapped survivors at 563 Clay St, a nearby commercial building, and the fire-threatened collapse cluster at 805 Clay St and 53 Waverly Pl, leaving zero drones in reserve.

missions.purpose: Survey unscanned high-occupancy buildings at Rincon Annex, the PG&E block, and the Park Tower block for major damage.
Confirm trapped survivors and assess fire spread at 53 Waverly Pl, 805 Clay St, and 563 Clay St.
Resolve damage discrepancies at Hyatt Regency, 388 Market, and 100 Pine Center, and sweep the 50 Fremont block.
